items.q: Which enzyme begins protein digestion in the stomach?
items.qAf: Watter ensiem begin proteïenvertering in die maag?
items.explain: Pepsin, activated by stomach acid, breaks proteins into smaller peptides.
items.explainAf: Pepsien, geaktiveer deur maagsuur, breek proteïene af in kleiner peptiede.

items.q: What is the role of bile in fat digestion?
items.qAf: Wat is die rol van gal in vetvertering?
options: It emulsifies fats into small droplets
optionsAf: Dit emulgeer vet in klein druppels
items.explain: Bile breaks large fat globules into small droplets, increasing the surface for lipase.
items.explainAf: Gal breek groot vetbolletjies in klein druppels, wat die oppervlak vir lipase vergroot.

items.q: Where are most nutrients absorbed into the blood?
items.qAf: Waar word die meeste voedingstowwe in die bloed geabsorbeer?
items.explain: Villi of the small intestine give a large surface for absorption.
items.explainAf: Villi van die dunderm gee ’n groot oppervlak vir absorpsie.

items.q: Herbivores can digest cellulose because of:
items.qAf: Herbivore kan sellulose verteer as gevolg van:
options: Symbiotic microbes in the rumen or caecum
optionsAf: Simbiotiese mikrobes in die rumen of caecum
items.explain: Symbiotic microbes produce cellulase, which breaks down cellulose.
items.explainAf: Simbiotiese mikrobes maak sellulase, wat sellulose afbreek.

items.q: Ruminants chew the cud so that:
options: Plant material is broken down mechanically for microbes
optionsAf: Plantmateriaal meganies afgebreek word vir mikrobes
items.explain: Chewing the cud reduces particle size, giving microbes more surface to work on.
items.explainAf: Kou van die koud verklein deeltjies, sodat mikrobes meer oppervlak het om op te werk.

items.q: Why do herbivores generally have long intestines?
items.qAf: Hoekom het herbivore gewoonlik lang derms?
options: To absorb more time for digesting plant material
optionsAf: Om meer tyd te gee vir die vertering van plantmateriaal
items.explain: Plant cellulose is hard to digest, so a long gut gives more time for microbial digestion.
items.explainAf: Plantsellulose is moeilik om te verteer, dus gee ’n lang derm meer tyd vir mikrobiese vertering.
